display_long_description:
**Any PC game or movie in immersive 3D with Mixed Reality effects**

InMotion streams your PC to your Meta Quest and turns any flat game, movie or video into 3D in real time. No mods, no special VR versions, no file conversion: your whole library works as it is. Turn your head, and the world turns with you.

## What you get

- **2D to 3D for anything on screen.** On Quest 3 and 3S the headset can compute depth itself and leave your graphics card to the game.
- **Mixed reality (beta).** Rain, snow, leaves, a sandstorm, underwater or space from the picture come into your room. Scan your room once, and snow and leaves settle on your floor and furniture.
- **One or two screens.** Add a second monitor or a virtual one at the resolution you need. Grab a frame to move it, pull a corner to resize it.
- **Consoles too.** PS5 and Xbox via Remote Play on your PC.
- **Smooth picture.** Up to 500 Mbps and 72 to 120 Hz matched to your game.
- **Your controls.** Controllers, gamepad, keyboard and mouse, head tracking or a laser pointer.

## What you'll need

- A **Windows 10 or 11 PC** or a **Mac** with Apple Silicon (beta), with the free InMotion desktop app: inmotion.cybionyx.space
- **5 GHz Wi-Fi** with the PC wired to the router, or a **USB-C cable**
- Meta Quest 2, 3, 3S or Pro

## Good to know

- It is a big virtual screen with depth, not a full 6DOF VR version of your games.
- Protected video in some apps can show a black picture: the system does not allow capturing it.
